classification.difficultyReason: Interpret inclusive bounds and select direct summation or a complement.

content.prompt: A torch manufacturer finds that on average 9% of the bulbs are defective. What is the probability that in a randomly selected batch of ten one-bulb torches each of the following occurs? Give your answers correct to five decimal places.

children.label: a
children.prompt: There will be no more than two with defective bulbs.

answer.worked:
Let $X$ be the number with defective bulbs, so $X\sim\operatorname{Bin}(10,0.09)$.
$$\begin{align*}P(X\le2)&=P(X=0)+P(X=1)+P(X=2)\\&=(0.91)^{10}+\binom{10}{1}(0.09)(0.91)^9+\binom{10}{2}(0.09)^2(0.91)^8\\&\approx0.94596.\end{align*}$$

children.label: b
children.prompt: There will be at least two with defective bulbs.

answer.worked:
$X\sim\operatorname{Bin}(10,0.09)$. The complementary outcomes are zero or one defective bulb.
$$\begin{align*}P(X\ge2)&=1-P(X=0)-P(X=1)\\&=1-(0.91)^{10}-\binom{10}{1}(0.09)(0.91)^9\\&\approx0.22545.\end{align*}$$
